metadata.title: Stock market today: Dow ends 620 points lower, Nasdaq drops and S&P 500 snaps 9-day win streak as tech wobbles, oil climbs to highest level in more than a week - MarketWatch

content.text:
Stock market today: Dow ends 620 points lower, Nasdaq drops and S&P 500 snaps 9-day win streak as tech wobbles, oil climbs to highest level in more than a week
Stocks close lower Wednesday, with the S&P 500 snapping a 9-session climb as tech shares fell and oil prices climbed.
